observation: Replaying the frozen ANTIXSS-1 task in voku/anti-xss (commit d0b62aa) as an installed consumer produced an untracked 5.3 MB .agent-map/phpstan-cache/ directory. anti-xss had already adopted the documented boundary correctly - .gitattributes export-ignores /.agent-loop and /tools/agent-loop, and tools/agent-loop pins platform.php - but neither its .gitignore nor its .gitattributes covers /.agent-map, because docs/compact-layout.md states that .agent-map/ maps to .agent-loop/map/ without exception. `git status` in the consumer therefore reported `?? .agent-map/`, which a consumer can commit and ship in a Composer dist. The path is hardcoded in agent-map's PhpStanSemanticAnalyzer::resultCacheDirectory() as $root . '/.agent-map/phpstan-cache' with no CLI option, so agent-loop cannot redirect it the way it now redirects the search index.

evidence.summary: After `agent-loop map build --paths=src` in the anti-xss consumer, `du -sh .agent-map` reported 5.3M and `git status --short` listed `?? .agent-map/`. vendor/voku/agent-map/src/Build/PhpStanSemanticAnalyzer.php:241 hardcodes the directory; grep found no cache-location option in agent-map's CliOptions.

agent-loop's own .gitignore carries /.agent-map/, which reads as migration residue but is load-bearing for this exact reason - which is how the incompleteness stayed invisible in the flagship repository.

hypothesis: A migration mapping documented as complete stops being checked. The one path that did not migrate is the one a consumer meets first, and the flagship repository hides it behind an ignore rule that looks like leftover.
validated_conclusion: docs/compact-layout.md now names the exception, gives consumers the .gitignore and .gitattributes lines, and states that agent-loop's own /.agent-map/ ignore rule is deliberate. Redirecting the cache requires a cache-location option in agent-map; that is a separate package change with no failing case yet, so it was not made here.
